memory_update.text: Use CoreWeave as the reference neocloud benchmark for specialized AI cloud capacity, but avoid letting it crowd out upstream powered-capacity suppliers.

Applied Digital, Core Scientific, and TeraWulf are better fits for this Layer 1B search focus than general hyperscalers because they map to power-connected AI data-center capacity and colocation constraints.

The most investable chokepoint signal in this node is not GPU ownership alone; it is the combination of secured power, high-density data-center readiness, credible customers, and financing survivability.

Need a later pass focused on balance-sheet stress: GPU-backed debt, lease obligations, project finance, customer concentration, depreciation schedules, and whether contracted MW becomes billable MW on time.

node: Specialized AI cloud capacity and GPU-as-a-service infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around scarce AI cloud capacity, focusing on companies that either operate GPU clouds directly or supply power-connected, high-density data-center capacity to neoclouds. The list uses CoreWeave as the reference anchor, then prioritizes less obvious infrastructure/hosting providers where the bottleneck is not just GPU access but powered land, high-density colocation, customer-backed financing, and execution speed. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
